Name: Meronoth
Description: A town that gave its name to Jehdeiah the Meronothite, one of David's overseers, and to Jadon the Meronothite, who helped repair Jerusalem's wall under Nehemiah.
BiblicalSignificance: Meronoth is remembered through its men: an overseer of David's asses and a builder of Nehemiah's wall, both called by their town.
